name: Determine the molarity of potassium permanganate using 0.05 M oxalic acid
subject: chemistry
ncert_reference: Manual of Microscale Chemistry Laboratory Kit, Chapter Volumetric Analysis, Experiment 2.5; exact PDF pages to verify during citation pass
educational_goal: Perform the Class 12 microscale chemistry experiment 'Determine the molarity of potassium permanganate using 0.05 M oxalic acid' and record its manual-defined observations and result.
materials: two burettes, oxalic acid, potassium permanganate, dilute sulphuric acid, conical flasks, heat source
safety_notes: Follow the supplied manual and teacher supervision for quantities, heating, acids, bases, organic solvents, and waste disposal.
Wear eye protection and do not taste or directly handle chemicals.
